ns2:course.label: The Art of Web Programming
ns2:course.description: Client- and server-side technologies that enable modern Web applications. Topics include the building blocks of the Web (browsers, HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and data exchange (HTTP, AJAX, JSON, REST). Assignments expose students to full-stack web development, and JavaScript frameworks that scaffold MVC architectures and event-driven, asynchronous programming. The course culminates in a final project, where students work in teams to design and develop an original, database-backed web application. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CS 225.
